family_exceptions: MSVC 19.50 AVX2 f32 tanh routes to xsimd
MSVC 19.50 AVX2 f32 tanh-GELU routes to xsimd

TSAN.reason: The v3 provider route is compile-time state and introduced no shared mutable state.

performance.ordinary_row_dtype: PASS: every qualified 95% lower bound is above 0.95
performance.activation_exception: PASS: xsimd materially wins all four admitted tanh/GELU rows and is the shipped route
performance.route_codegen: PASS: fixed/exact provider selection disappears at compile time; ordinary/source-fat has only one cached whole-buffer target call
performance.claim_limit: Engineering evidence covers the frozen ordinary/source-primary groups, not every operation, platform, size or Formal SOTA. SVE/RVV have no silicon performance claim.

product_provider_dependencies.runtime_abi: none; both are authenticated header-only product inputs

admitted_families: continuous row algebra and mixed/storage dot
whole-buffer math, activations, softmax and log-softmax
canonical bitpack and reproducible non-cryptographic batch RNG
sort, partial-sort, select, stable radix-sort and argsort
capability.inference_boundary: No unowned admitted SIMD MUST remains. Tensor layout, block quant formats, GEMM, attention, RoPE, operator fusion and GPU policy remain Compute/engine responsibilities.
capability.public_shape: C++23 pointer/count, span and HYLE-owned POD/storage types; source-only fixed/fat expert seams keep vendor register types inside target-bound translation units.

known_limitations: SVE and RVV are correctness/codegen qualified under QEMU; no real-silicon performance winner is claimed.
Classic cl.exe is capped at AVX2 for direct Highway target bodies by the upstream AVX3 blocklist; clang-cl is required for direct AVX-512.
SIMD provides no Native FFI, C ABI or stable cross-toolchain C++ ABI.
The minimal Highway VQSort adaptation must be rebased and re-audited when its upstream source changes.
reopen_triggers: A locked Highway/xsimd or integrated VQSort source upgrade changes an affected route or contract.
A real inference consumer demonstrates an unowned reusable SIMD primitive or a reproducible correctness defect.
Qualified same-contract evidence shows a material route reversal on a supported compiler/ISA scope.
New hardware or compiler support changes the finite target matrix, especially SVE/RVV silicon or classic-MSVC AVX3 support.
A concrete foreign-runtime consumer passes Native FFI admission and requires a runtime-owned type-erased boundary.
